predict_steps.prompt: Window size equals len(s1). For s1='ab', what is that size?
predict_steps.hint: Fixed window length matches the pattern string.

viva.question: Why does a fixed window the size of s1 detect a permutation inside s2 in linear time?
expected_points: the window length equals len(s1) so multisets are comparable
sliding updates character counts in constant time per step
total work is linear in the length of s2
matching counts means the window is a rearrangement of s1

viva.question: What breaks when s2 is shorter than s1?
expected_points: no window of the needed length fits
count comparison never gets a full window to test

viva.question: Why do equal frequency counts prove a permutation?
expected_points: a permutation is exactly the same multiset of characters
order inside the window does not matter
any mismatched count rules the window out
the invariant is that satisfied need counters cover every character of s1
